newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Glory parent orders six bulk carriers.
newsitem.headline: Top Glory parent orders six bulk carriers.

text.p: Top Glory Holding Co Ltd, the parent of Hong Kong-listed Top Glory International Holdings Ltd, said on Tuesday it had ordered six new bulk carriers worth a total of US$150 million.
Including its existing five vessels, and seven other vessels already on order, the latest order would lift its fleet to 18 vessels by the end of 1999, Top Glory Holding said in a statement.

Top Glory Holding said the order was placed through subsidiary Top Glory Shipping Co Ltd and comprised orders for two vessels each weighing 30,000 metric tonnes of deadweight, (MTDW), and four vessels of 74,000 MTDW each, it said.
Top Glory International shares closed on Monday at HK$1.59.
